notes.title: Gameplay Update - v0.1.5b
notes.content:
Gameplay Updates
Major performance enhancements. Players should now experience less FPS drops

Minor QoL updates to the DA-Move shop

The D-Pad now also works on controllers

Minor tweaks/nerfs to some DA-Moves that either overperformed OR caused FPS Drops

Killed enemies now cause a small 0.5 sec burst of light on their death location



Join us on our Discord Community! https://discord.gg/EKh7dcXn
Check out our socials! https://linktr.ee/basikagames

notes.title: PGDX 2025 Update - v0.1.5a
notes.content:
Gameplay Updates
Removed the v0.1 tutorial, changing it to a less handholdy, straightforward one that tries to get the player up to speed as fast as possible

Changed the song order for the Stage 1 prototype

Old: Counterpoint -> Tooth and Nail -> Tell Me More -> Heads or Tails

New: Tooth and Nail -> Tell Me More -> March of Mischief -> Heads or Tails

Various improvements in quality of life, visuals, performance and gamefeel


DA-Move Updates
Added 4 new DA-Moves, three of which are named after the 3 players who got a one million score in our PGDX leaderboard

Kinetic Clap (Charged)

S-Amandil (Basic)
